requirements.text: The portal shall allow policyholders to view policies, download documents, raise service requests and make online premium payments.
The bidder must provide UX/UI design and a responsive, accessible front end as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must provide a content-managed corporate website as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must provide a secure customer portal with authentication and role-based access as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must integrate with the existing core policy system via REST APIs as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must integrate an online payment gateway as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must deploy the solution to the Corporation's cloud environment as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must provide one year of warranty support with defined response times as part of the scope of work.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 quality management certification.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 information security certification.
The bidder must have completed at least three web or software development projects each valued at not less than PKR 5 Million in the last five years.
The bidder must be registered with the Federal Board of Revenue and hold active taxpayer (ATL) status.
The bidder must furnish bid security of 2% of the quoted price as a bank guarantee or CDR from a scheduled bank.
The proposed solution should use a modern, maintainable web stack and provide a content management system for non-technical staff.
The portal should support secure authentication, role-based access control and an audit trail of user actions.
The bidder should integrate the existing core policy system through documented REST APIs and a tested payment gateway.
The solution should be responsive across desktop and mobile and meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.
The bidder should provide a one-year support plan with a helpdesk and a defined response time for critical issues.
The bidder should provide user training and complete technical documentation at handover.
Bidders scoring below 70 out of 100 in the technical proposal evaluation will not proceed to financial evaluation.
The bidder must submit written queries by 18 June 2026 if it wishes to raise queries.
The bidder must submit the proposal by 30 June 2026 at 03:00 PM.
The bidder must keep its bid valid for 90 days.
The bidder must submit proposals in two sealed envelopes marked "Technical" and "Financial".
The bidder must submit one original and one copy each of the technical and financial proposals.
The bidder must address the submission to the Chief Manager (IT), State Life Insurance Corporation, Principal Office, Karachi.

The bidder must include in its proposal responses to Q1 Company profile and relevant experience, Q2 understanding of requirements and proposed solution, Q3 project plan and timeline, Q4 team and CVs, and Q5 support and maintenance plan.
